title: Two photos of Tiger Woods taken 16 years apart show how much smartphones have changed the world (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL)
text: Two photos of Tiger Woods taken 16 years apart show how much smartphones have changed the world (AAPL, GOOG, GOOGL) By Kif Leswing Aug 11, 2018, 10:30 am 32 pts Tiger Woods is playing the PGA Championship this weekend, and while there's no guarantee that he'll even make the cut, it's sure there will be a lot of photos of the legendary golfer. You can see people snapping pictures with their phones every time he tees off. Tiger's career has been so long…
